title: Agentic OS slash-command frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of a Claude Code slash command (.claude/commands/<name>.md). The command name is the filename stem (no 'name' field). The markdown BODY is the prompt and is checked separately by validate.mjs. Commands are Claude-only — Codex has no native command dispatch (see spec.md).

description.description: One-line help text shown in the /command picker. Says what the command does.

argument-hint.description: Hint for the $ARGUMENTS the command expects, e.g. '[pr-number]' or ['client', 'ask'].

allowed-tools.description: Comma-separated tool allow-list the command body may use (e.g. 'Read, Edit, Bash').

model.description: Optional model override for the command run (e.g. claude-opus-4-8).

disable-model-invocation.description: When true, the command is human-invocable only (the model will not auto-trigger it).
